'''Berric''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] and served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]]. During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], he supplied his fellow officers with weapons from a small shop near the taxi station in [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] [[Black Sun territory|territory]].<ref name="TOR" />

Berric was a large, [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] with brown, balding hair, brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and he had fair skin. Berric wore a [[Coruscant Security Force uniform]] and carried a large [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Berric appears in the [[BioWare]] MMORPG ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a weapons vendor on Coruscant.
